title: Adiong to Remulla: PNP’s role is to ensure safety, not cause panic

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong has reminded Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla that the role of the police is to ensure public safety and not cause panic, after the latter claimed that police officers are preparing for the worst possible scenario after the impeachment trial.
